Requirement: The system shall send a verification link by email after registration and block booking until the email is verified.

The system shall allow a user who forgot their password to request a reset link by email; the link expires after 30 minutes, is single-use, is invalidated by a newer request, and the response does not reveal whether the email exists.
The system shall also send the GEN-01 notifications (plus moderator invitations) by email via SMTP, using a test inbox in development.

The system shall allow a registered user to change a Confirmed flight booking's date or flight (same route and cabin), paying any fare difference via Stripe or receiving a refund of a lower fare, subject to seat availability.
The system shall allow seat selection.
The system shall allow a hotel moderator to reply to a review.
The system shall allow booked flights and hotels to be linked to itinerary days, feeding the budget.
The system shall allow a user to export or print an itinerary as PDF.
The system shall allow an author to attach an itinerary to a post.
The system shall provide an admin analytics dashboard showing bookings and revenue per provider over a selected period.
The system shall allow a registered user to save hotels and public itineraries to a favourites list and view it.
